I see filmmaking not only as a profession but also as a way to express perspectives and connect with audiences. Joining Qura Film Academy is an important step in my journey because I want to strengthen my skills, gain professional knowledge, learn from experienced mentors, and understand every aspect of filmmaking in depth. My goal is to grow as a filmmaker, develop my own unique style, and create impactful films that can connect with people and leave a meaningful mark in the industry.
